title: Critical Assessment of a Novel Vitrification Platform with Enhanced Robustness Using a Grid Quality Framework with AI-based Image Scoring
content: In the past decade cryo-EM has established itself as the fastest growing structural biology technique thanks to continued innovation that allowed the technique to become more robust and achieve ever higher resolution routinely. Its inherent advantages, such as the ability to solve structures of previously very challenging proteins (e.g., GPCRs), fuels the promise of cryo-EM to become more readily available for researchers currently not studying protein structures. However, one of the main bottlenecks for cryo-EM adoption by non-expert users is preparing good cryo-EM samples. A 2023 summary from NanoImaging Services (NIS) showed that only 8% of the samples they receive are able to yield a high-resolution structures without excessive optimization, indicating the limited success that current vitrification solutions offer [1].
